breaks_found.family: corrupt kinematics (found while probing the requested families)
breaks_found.description: A single non-finite kinematic sample (NaN or ±Infinity in value OR timestamp) poisoned the peak (Math.max) and every threshold derived from it, letting a QUIET window slip past the no-meaningful-swing gate and emit a garbage full-window timeline. Reproduced on v1 anchored, v2 anchored, and v2 anchor-free (flat series + one Infinity sample fabricated a motion peak).
breaks_found.fix: finiteSamples() filter drops non-finite samples before any gate in v1 and in the v2 anchor-free slice; remaining coverage/sample-count gates then judge only real observations. NOT a blanket abstention: a real synthetic swing bump with injected NaN samples still segments (regression-tested).

breaks_found.description: Anchor-free mode promoted ONE of several near-equal wheelchair-propulsion peaks (sin^2 rhythm, period 900ms) to 'the swing apex' and segmented a full timeline around an arbitrary wheel push. The 2x-median prominence gate does not detect multi-modality: identical rival peaks keep the median low while none of them is a unique apex.
breaks_found.fix: PHASE_PEAK_NOT_UNIQUE gate: any rival sample >180ms away from the apex with value >= 0.9x apex aborts anchor-free segmentation. Anchored mode is unaffected (a trusted contact anchor between/on pushes still yields an ordered timeline — regression-tested). Anchor-free version string re-versioned v2.1 -> v2.2 because abstention semantics changed.

families_probed_no_break: truncated clips (starts mid-backswing): preparation stays null (unknown), never invented; anchor-free pre-peak evidence gate abstains — 2 regression tests pin this

no visible follow-through: anchored path abstains with PHASE_NO_POST_CONTACT_EVIDENCE when the clip ends at contact (never an inverted timeline); a single post-contact observation is the minimum honest bound; anchor-free post-peak gate abstains — 3 regression tests

compact dink events <100ms: at 30fps the event cannot carry enough in-window samples -> honest abstention; the SAME dink at 120fps segments with valid ordering and contact inside the event (abstention is evidence-driven, not event-size-driven) — 3 regression tests
geometric segmenter (vision-geometry/phaseSegmenter.ts): NaN pose coordinates fail closed with phase.no_distinct_stroke; no fabricated boundaries observed; no change needed
invariants_asserted: phase ordering (preparation <= acceleration <= contact|peak < followThroughEnd <= recovery), unobservable boundaries null / abstained (never invented), accel <= contact, checkArtifactInvariants == [] on every segmented output incl. 300-seed corruption fuzz

positive_coverage_before_after.note: measured with datasets/experiments/wave-d3/d3-05-measure-gold.ts + d3-05-measure-fuzz.ts on committed wave-a gold (13 events, 8 dev bundles; SYNTHETIC-free, held-out-free) and the propertyInvariants 300-seed fuzz corpus

fuzz_300_seeds_segmented.delta_explanation: the 10 lost fuzz segmentations are random-walk series with multiple near-equal spikes — exactly the multi-modal pattern B2 says must abstain; zero loss on committed positive gold
